description: For each of a voter control and nonvoter discriminator, bootstrap four real Raft nodes with three voters, execute electSelf and actual peer vote handlers, register a fresh verification on the initialized leader context, then execute exactly one selected real heartbeat exchange. Join the heartbeat worker and compare the actual tally with independently counted eligible successful acknowledgements. Observe threshold notification but do not claim public Future completion or a stale-read endpoint.

harness.description: Isolated main-thread entry check with real in-memory transport, receiver processRPC/appendEntries, verification registration, heartbeat, notifyAll and verifyFuture.vote. Each operation has its own cluster and identity.
semantic_changes: No target source changes. skipStartup suppresses autonomous timers and goroutines; the driver runs peer RPC consumers.
Campaign-loop scheduling is replaced by consuming real electSelf vote responses and applying the sourced majority transition; configuration remains the bootstrapped fixed configuration.

The driver materializes per-peer worker structs from startStopReplication initialization and schedules only the selected heartbeat after verifyLeader registers the future. Other worker replies are delayed beyond this observation interval.
No runLeader no-op or FSM application is required for the selected verifyLeader entry; the check stops at tally/threshold notification rather than claiming public API completion.
Transport wrapper stops its heartbeat after the actual underlying RPC returns, independently of tally outcome. Timers are long to leave the bounded schedule before lease/election expiry.

legality.derivation: NewRaft skipStartup constructs the same state without starting loops. Bootstrap supplies valid unique fixed membership and durable initial configuration. electSelf and peer requestVote execute actual term/vote persistence and supply three grants before the driver applies the majority state transition. setupLeaderState is real; worker initialization matches startStopReplication and includes the nonvoter because that function creates workers for all nonlocal servers. verifyLeader is called by the sole leader owner. Delaying other workers is an allowed asynchronous schedule; the selected real heartbeat reaches actual appendEntries through InmemTransport and processRPC. The wrapper neither forges response success nor changes term/suffrage. Joining the worker ensures notifyAll has returned before observing the tally.
legality.applicability: Local verification eligibility only, fixed protocol-3 membership, no storage failures or concurrent configuration changes. The observed interval executes one selected acknowledgement after registration.
alternatives: Full autonomous cluster execution could test endpoint consequences, but is not required to observe this local count responsibility.

grounding.derivation: Observe final v.votes only after the actual heartbeat worker joins. Eligible count derives from fixed configuration suffrage and real RPC success, independently of the tally; initial self voter is included. Event identity is the operation label shared with registration, not the compared tally.
grounding.applicability: One fresh operation per selected-peer control; result is emitted regardless of tally outcome.

observable_properties.description: The observed verification tally must not exceed successful eligible acknowledgements (including the local voter); counting a Nonvoter violates the accepted local eligibility duty.

uncertainties: The check observes tally and threshold notification, not VerifyLeader Future success or a client read endpoint.
Campaign scheduling and worker creation are explicit driver substitutions; actual election grants and actual selected heartbeat receiver execute in the same per-case history.
